definitions.short: a halter (as restraining ); by implication, the jaw
definitions.full: H7448. resen I. רֶ֫סֶן noun masculine Isa 30:28 : 1 halter ; 2 jaw (?); — 1 absolute ׳ר Psa 32:9 restraining mouth of horse or ass (+ מֶתֶג ); figurative of עַמִּים׳ר עַללְֿחָיֵי י, ׳שֵׁם Isa 30:28 ; ׳ר שִׁלֵּ֑חוּ מִמָּנַי Job 30:11 , i.e. threw off restraint. 2 suffix רִסְנוֺ כֶּפֶל Job 41:5 the double of his jaw , his double jaws (of croc.), si vera 1.; connection of meanings strange, || לְבוּשׁוֺ מְּנֵי , whence GHBW right Du conjecture סִיֹנוֺ .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to curb ;
